'''Gank comm implants''' were [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic implants]] that were implanted into most members of the [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The implants allowed for cybernetic communication between Ganks.<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
